answer: one vault holds a ratchet per operator and mints violet only when that ratchet advances one judged epoch; a head must spend fresh violet to act, and keys sharing custody fold, burning their velvet. first head: 1 epoch, 1 velvet. an operator’s kth live head demands k more ratchet steps and k velvet, so n clones pay n(n+1)/2 serial epochs plus n(n+1)/2 velvet; fresh keys inherit the fold.
